character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist in every shot: soft black hair with snow-dusted fringe, warm brown eyes, with a stable distinctive face and adult proportions. They are a mountain inn caretaker who prepares the outdoor bath before dawn. Their signature costume is a dark indigo hanten coat over a simple work kimono, wool leggings, and winter sandals. Their defining personal object is a small cedar ladle carved with a snowflake. Keep face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining object consistent across every scene.
consistency_rules: Maintain one fixed lead character for the full theme video.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Preserve the signature outfit design and the same personal item or tool in all scenes.
Do not change the protagonist or add a second lead unless the lyrics explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in outdoor stone bath in snow, wooden inn with lit windows, snowy path with lanterns; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with steam white, snow blue, lantern amber, cedar brown; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow push-in through rising steam, wide shot of a snowy mountain inn, low shot of snow falling on hot water; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
